title: 15.79. Saraṇaduka, Ācayagāmittika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Saraṇaṁ ācayagāmiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo naācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Araṇaṁ apacayagāmiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nasaraṇo naapacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Araṇaṁ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṁ dhammaṁ paccayā naaraṇo nanevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
